# 2 · Install Git & Clone the Repository

## 2.1 Install Git

| Platform | Install | Verify |
|----------|---------|--------|
| **macOS** | `brew install git` | `git --version` |
| **Windows** | `choco install git -y` | `git --version` |

> If macOS prompts for Xcode Command‑Line Tools, accept the install — Homebrew relies on them.

## 2.2 Generate an SSH key *(Optional)*

```bash
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@willamette.edu"
pbcopy < ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub   # macOS
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub        # Windows Git Bash
```

Add the key to your GitHub account (Settings → SSH Keys).

## 2.3 Clone Pedalogical

We keep all project repos in `~/GitHub` for consistency.

```bash
cd ~
mkdir -p GitHub && cd GitHub
git clone git@github.com:wu-software-lab/AiTutor.git   # SSH
# or
git clone https://github.com/wu-software-lab/AiTutor.git  # HTTPS
cd AiTutor
git status
```

### Keeping your fork up‑to‑date

```bash
git remote add upstream https://github.com/wu-software-lab/AiTutor.git
git pull upstream main
```
